h: KC Luxury reportedly arrives at Lagos court in an ambulance as lawyer seeks medical bail
p: Socialite KC Luxury was reportedly brought to a Lagos court in an ambulance, with his lawyer asking for bail on medical grounds. He is facing a multi-count drug-related case brought by the anti-narcotics agency and has denied the charges.
more: He earlier pleaded not guilty to all counts alongside two co-defendants.
His lawyers have also challenged his detention in a separate suit.
